title: Retry an initially invalid Project Manifest
invariant: When initial Manifest selection raises ValueError, the supervisor keeps a diagnostic service available and retries admission after the retry delay.
scope: Exact archived module ASTs, initial direct-project startup, select raising ValueError, healthy gate and diagnostic operations, no stop request, and no running MCP. Lean models the startup, retry and diagnostic branch facts; it does not prove Python semantics, timing, process execution, HTTP health, or successful later repair. Other module shapes are unresolved.

fixed.revision: archived canary runtime overlay, not a Git revision

provenance: The archived thr_5je2jn33zw/startup-replay-image/canary.json records the mounted runtime file hash and a separate Manifest recovery canary outcome. The overlay is not represented as a Git revision.
